lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters; density increases anteriorly toward the branchial region, with larger, more isolated centroids positioned posteriorly along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like grid where circular spots serve as anchor nodes at or between the vertical-horizontal intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank exhibiting a high-contrast luminance gradient, with specular highlights on the dorsal aspect and deep shadowing on the ventral aspect of the ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 4 to 6 discrete high-luminance blobs localized within the visible macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a slender, dark, high-contrast silhouette (remora) positioned ventrally to the mid-section and a secondary similar silhouette trailing the posterior pelvic region.
